subject: POC MAP & env prep: BrightHealth pilot (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — MAP and environment asks

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency and cost numbers you shared. We're keen to move forward with a four-week pilot focused on a single use-case (clinical triage summaries). Before we lock dates, we need a short mutual action plan that captures the POC scope and the environment pre-reqs on both sides. Key items our infra/security team flagged:

- Org & API keys: we need a sandbox org for evaluation and short-lived API credentials (with clear rotation guidance).
- IP allowlist: we can open egress from our app but need your public egress targets (and the CIDR ranges you expect for the dedicated sandbox).
- VPC peering: we'll prefer peering if possible, otherwise a secure NAT path; need your recommended subnet ranges and any route table notes.
- Data handling: confirmation that logs are segregated for the sandbox and retention defaults.

Attached is our MVP requirements doc to help you scope (BrightHealth-MVP-requirements.pdf). Goal: pilot start 2026-09-07 and end by 2026-10-05. Can you send a draft MAP and a proposed kickoff date for a preflight call next week?

Alan
Head of Platform
BrightHealth

- BrightHealth (Alan / Priya): provide production and sandbox egress ranges (CIDR), networking contact for peering, and confirmation of required audit logs. Deliver by 2026-08-30.
- Joint: preflight and connectivity test window 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-03. Pilot start: 2026-09-07.

Action items (owners):
1) Sandbox org + API key (Tessa / Aditya) — temp key, TTL 30 days, scope: generation/chat only.
2) IP allowlist + peering notes (Aditya) — include required routes and port list.
3) Security checklist (Soojin) — minimum audit logs, retention defaults, and KMS rotation note.
4) DocuSign SOW (Tessa) — we'll prepare a short SOW for the pilot (statement of work + payment terms).

I've attached the MAP draft (MAP-draft-Redwood-BrightHealth.xlsx) — it's intentionally minimal so we can iterate in the call.

Talk soon,

Alan / Tessa — quick technical notes and a concrete ask from infra to make the preflight productive: 

1) IP allowlist: please provide both sandbox and prod egress ranges in CIDR format. For peering we typically request a /22 or /24 depending on the account (either is fine for a single-service pilot). Example placeholder: 35.240.128.0/24 (Redwood egress).

2) VPC peering: we support both direct peering and NAT'ed HTTPS egress. For peering we need: your VPC CIDR, identification of the region, and whether you require asymmetric routing. Our peering checklist (attached) covers route propagation and required IAM roles.

3) API keys & org: we'll provision a sandbox org with a scoped key (chat + generation). We recommend a short TTL (30 days) and a monitor hook to revoke if abnormal usage is detected. We'll also deliver explicit rotation steps (KMS-backed keys).

4) Ports & firewall: only outbound 443 to our endpoints is required; for peering we ask to ensure BGP routes are exchanged if you want private addresses.

Attached: vpc-peering-checklist.md — it contains the minimal steps we run in the preflight. If you can send the CIDR + preferred peering windows by 2026-08-30 we can lock the kickoff.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
